m.n: The Nature of God: The Holy Trinity

co.n: The Nature of God: The Holy Trinity Cohort

c.p: How does the Nicene Creed describe the relationship between God the Father and God the Son?
c.a: consubstantial | homoousios | same substance | of the same essence
c.h: It means "of the same substance" or divine essence.
c.e: The Nicene Creed states the Son is consubstantial (homoousios) with the Father, begotten before all ages and not created (CCC 242).
r: Catholic theology affirms the Son is "begotten, not made", decisively avoiding the Arian heresy.
